title: DriveGen on an iPad (landscape, Agent screen as home): Settings opens from the app grid

steps.why: DriveGen in Chrome as an iPad

steps.js: openView('home'); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 800)); const t = [...document.querySelectorAll('.app-tile')].find(e => /^settings$/i.test(e.textContent.trim())); t.scrollIntoView(); Peek.tapAt = Date.now(); t.click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1200)); return current
steps.why: Tap Settings on the app grid
